note: Coding assistant with project memory. The project migrates databases. The ORM, migrations tool, test setup and search implementation depend on it (migrations depend via the ORM: 2 hops). Redis, CI, language and a different personal project that also uses a database must stay.

memories.text: The user's ShopKart backend uses PostgreSQL 15 as its main database.
The ShopKart backend uses SQLAlchemy as its ORM for all database models.
ShopKart schema changes are managed with Alembic migrations generated from the SQLAlchemy models.
ShopKart's integration tests start a Postgres container with docker-compose before running.
ShopKart reads the Postgres connection string from the DATABASE_URL environment variable.
ShopKart's product search uses PostgreSQL full-text search with GIN indexes.
The ShopKart backend is written in Python 3.12 with FastAPI.
ShopKart caches product listings in Redis with a 10-minute TTL.
ShopKart's CI runs on GitHub Actions for every pull request.
ShopKart is deployed on AWS ECS in the ap-south-1 region.
The user's personal side project is a Rust command-line expense tracker that stores data in SQLite.
The user prefers pytest over unittest for Python tests.
The user wants type hints on all functions and Google-style docstrings.
The user's team does code reviews on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
The user's team lead on ShopKart is Ananya.
The user codes in VS Code with Vim keybindings.
The user is preparing for the AWS Solutions Architect Associate exam.
The user prefers short, focused pull requests under 400 lines.

observation.text: We finished migrating ShopKart off Postgres. The backend now runs entirely on MongoDB Atlas.
